reason: Expert identifies a known false alarm for battery alarms caused by extremely cold weather confusing the temperature sensor, avoiding an unnecessary field trip.

knowledge.summary: Severe cold can cause the rectifier temperature sensor to fail and report incorrect values, triggering a false battery alarm. Verify the temperature sensor reading and battery voltage before dispatching a technician.
knowledge.author: Sanna Siirto
knowledge.details: Temperature sensor reading dropped to -40 while battery voltage remained normal.
